name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=tile, descriptor=blit_24x24_remap). '24x24' is the sprite dimension (24 cols x 24 rows, x_remain inits 0x18 and 24 rows are blitted), a semantic constant -- NOT address residue. '_remap' accurately names the transform: every written pixel goes through out=palette_remap[src_byte], and on the 0x80+0x40 (0xC0..0xFF) branch the EXISTING dst byte is remapped in place (disasm 0x4dd3a MOV AL,[EDI]; 0x4dd3c MOV AL,[EBP+EAX]; STOSB), the documented distinction from the sibling fd2_tile_blit_24x24_with_remap_table @ 0x4dd52 which skips transparently on that branch. Name is descriptive and address-clean; no rename needed.
purpose: Hand-written RLE blit of a 24x24 sprite into a destination buffer, mapping every written pixel through a 256-entry palette translation LUT (out = palette_remap[src]); the in-place-remap variant of the tile_blit_24x24_* family.
logic_summary: Decodes the standard FD2 24x24 RLE stream one command byte at a time for 24 rows. Top 2 bits select mode, low 6 bits + 1 = run length, x_remain (BH) starts 0x18 per row, row counter (BL) starts 0x18. 00=RUN (remap one source byte, paint len contiguously, x-=len). 01=STRIDE-2 RUN (remap one source byte, paint len at every other dst byte via INC EDI+STOSB, x-=2*len). 10=LITERAL (copy len remapped source bytes one dst each, x-=len). 11=IN-PLACE REMAP (for len dst bytes write palette_remap[existing_dst_byte], no source consumed, x-=len). When x_remain reaches 0 the row ends and dst advances by stride-0x18; loop until 24 rows done. EBP register holds the palette_remap base used as the LUT index base. Hand-written asm leaf: no __CHK probe, no CALLs.
signature: void fd2_tile_blit_24x24_remap(uint32 rle_stream, uint32 dst_buf, uint32 stride, uint32 palette_remap)

params.name: rle_stream
params.semantics: Source RLE-encoded 24x24 sprite byte stream (caller passes pTile_sprite = battle_scene_snapshot + tile_offset_table[tile_id*4+6]).
params.reason: Accurately names the RLE source stream pointer; address-clean; consistent with sibling blitters.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (caller passes pDst_row, the current battle render-workspace row base).
params.reason: Accurately names the destination buffer pointer; address-clean.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes; the row reset advances dst by stride-0x18. Caller passes param_2 = dst_stride (0x140 for VGA).
params.reason: Accurately names the row stride; matches usage (SUB EDX,0x18 -> row advance).

params.name: palette_remap
params.semantics: 256-entry palette translation table base (caller resolves data_fd2_tile_anim_table_base + tile_anim_table[phase*4+6]); used as LUT index base in EBP for src and in-place dst remap.
params.reason: Accurately names the palette remap LUT base; address-clean. (Live Ghidra types this param int; src uses uint32 per Layer-2 convention -- value semantics identical, no type-change in scope.)

returns.semantics: No return value; writes 24x24 remapped pixels into dst_buf.
